level: calculation, not measured dynamics and not a powered circuit comparison
equation: C*dVF/dt=I_sink-I_LED(VF); ideal instantaneous sink100uA->25uA; same static PWL, no driver/gate/reference/package/optical/RX poles
method: Exact integral sum C*rd(segment)*log(abs((Istart-Itarget)/(Iend-Itarget))) across every PWL segment. Piecewise-resistance analytic control, no fitted lifetime.
limits: The200fF is a shared sensitivity assumption, not a fitted measured capacitance.
Package/driver conductance and transient gate/reference effects omitted; this is an isolation control, not proof of sole causality.
A voltage-output candidate can supply displacement current; this ideal fixed-current sink control does not describe A.
Full-frame transistor results continue to use real references/rails, never this ideal sink.
